scenarios.title: Fabricate puts counters on the permanent or creates Servo tokens when it enters
decisions: A casts Weaponcraft Enthusiast, tapping the three Swamps.
B has priority with the spell on the stack and passes; A passes. Weaponcraft Enthusiast resolves and enters the battlefield.
The fabricate trigger goes on the stack; both players pass. On resolution A chooses to put two +1/+1 counters on Weaponcraft Enthusiast.

variants.label: counters
variants.expected: The fabricate trigger fires on entering. Weaponcraft Enthusiast has two +1/+1 counters and is 2/3. No tokens are created.

variants.label: servos
variants.delta: On resolution of the fabricate trigger A chooses not to put counters on it.
variants.expected: Weaponcraft Enthusiast has no counters and stays 0/1. A creates two 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature tokens.

variants.label: spell_countered
variants.delta: B responds by casting Counterspell with both Islands, targeting Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
variants.expected: Weaponcraft Enthusiast is countered and moves to A's graveyard. It never enters the battlefield, so the fabricate trigger does not fire and no counters or tokens appear.

scenarios.title: Each instance of fabricate triggers separately
decisions: A casts Weaponcraft Enthusiast, tapping the three Swamps; it resolves and enters the battlefield.
Its fabricate 2 trigger and the fabricate 1 trigger from Cayth, Famed Mechanist both go on the stack.
On resolution of the fabricate 2 trigger A puts two +1/+1 counters on Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
On resolution of the fabricate 1 trigger A chooses not to put a counter on it.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Two separate fabricate triggers fire. Weaponcraft Enthusiast has two +1/+1 counters and is 2/3, and A creates one 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Cayth, Famed Mechanist is controlled by B instead of A.
variants.expected: Weaponcraft Enthusiast has only its own fabricate 2, so one trigger fires. It has two +1/+1 counters and is 2/3, and no Servo is created.

scenarios.forge_notes: Variant one_instance moves Cayth, Famed Mechanist to B's battlefield; its granted fabricate applies only to its controller's creatures.
